article.description: — Jaden Zimmerman scored 19 points as Quinnipiac beat Iona 89-68 on Friday night in a Metro Atlantic Athletic Conference opener.

article.story: NEW ROCHELLE, N.Y. -- — Jaden Zimmerman scored 19 points as Quinnipiac beat Iona 89-68 on Friday night in a Metro Atlantic Athletic Conference opener. Zimmerman added six rebounds, five assists, and three steals for the Bobcats (6-3). Grant Randall scored 13 points and added 10 rebounds. Asim Jones went 6 of 8 from the field to finish with 13 points. Lamin Sabally led the way for the Gaels (6-3) with 27 points, 14 rebounds and two steals. Keshawn Williams had 10 points and CJ Anthony totaled 10 points and seven assists. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
